bank_energy_error_and_conditioning.scope: Numerical exact-reference DA-CASE solve on the stored five-direction, eight-qubit BeH2 CAS(4e,4o) bank; the reported ground_energy is the retained subspace energy, not the full active-space ground energy.

grouping_and_logical_clifford_counts.scope: Word-universe, greedy setting counts, synthesized logical Clifford gate/depth counts and checked Z-only restrictions for the stored bank at block sizes 1, 2, 4 and 8; these describe the chosen synthesis, not an optimal grouping or routed hardware circuit.

uniform_shot_totals_and_break_even_ratio.scope: Preparation and CX-application projections at the assumed 8000 shots per setting, and preparation-versus-logical-CX cost ratios in the declared all-to-all logical model; no shot outcomes, finite-sample accuracy certificate, noise model or measured hardware runtime is present in this v2 record.
